Final categorization: EXCLUDED  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on future land use change projections in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau (QTP), which is a regional/transboundary area spanning multiple provinces but not an entire country. Although China is mentioned as the broader context, the study explicitly defines the QTP as the study area (~2.57 million km², ~1/4 of China’s land area) and does not implement analysis at the national (i.e., full Chinese territory) scale. This violates the core inclusion criterion requiring “explicit national-scale spatial implementation (entire country).” Additionally, while the paper uses multiple SSP scenarios and provides quantitative projections of land use change with mapped outputs, its geographic scope is regional—not national—thus meeting the exclusion criterion “Local/regional/global/transboundary scale focus.”)
